t: Drury House once stood here, on Wych Street, though it has gone now. It was the home of Sir Robert Drury, and Drury Lane takes its name from him. In 1601 it became a meeting place for Robert Devereux, Earl of Essex, and his accomplices as they plotted against Elizabeth the First. Elizabeth Stuart, later known as the Winter Queen after her brief reign as Queen of Bohemia, also lived here.
